set.description: Scene revision3. Use dedicated42 colors and upper-left light. Preserve original north large blocks, door states/hinge/opening, quiet floor and all completed actors. Replace only incompatible E/W/S stone, corners and junctions with large irregular2..3-cell courses, remove small bright flecks/micro-joints. Use explicit directional top/south/contact faces, contact<=2px. Connect north crowns to W side piers and low south cuts via stone-architecture.json. Native review inspects actual candidate and small directional repeated/seam samples1x/3x and writes {PACK}/verdict.json PASS/FAIL with every required slot and concrete pixel evidence. If local sample is missing, create/review it through existing adapter; do not redraw correct originals. Whole four-state room,12 faces/windows/board, work focus and all comparison obligations belong to post-collection art-context-review, not native component prerequisite.
